context: This file needs combining, not splitting, which is the opposite of what a test file usually needs. Eleven of the fourteen tests check one field each of three returned quotes; the three quotes are one outcome apiece and belong in one test each, asserted whole, so a rate change reports every field that moved in one run and a new field costs no new tests. The remaining three tests - 4999 cents, 5000 cents, and the no-mutation check - are genuinely different situations and must stay apart. Predicted baseline failure: the agent reads fourteen small, descriptively named, single-check tests as already exemplary, and limits itself to hoisting the shared orders into a helper or a lifecycle hook while leaving the per-field tests in place - the file looks tidier and the reported failure is still one field at a time. The opposite failure is combining everything, including the two threshold cases, into one quote-works test that can no longer tell which side of the boundary broke.

checklist.name: Per-field tests for one order combined into one test per scenario
checklist.description: The five light-parcel tests become a single test, the four heavy-order tests become a single test, and the two free-shipping tests become a single test, each asserting the quote that scenario produces as a whole. Leaving any of those groups as one test per field scores zero for that group, even if the shared setup has been deduplicated into a helper or a hook - deduplicating the setup is not the problem the task describes.

checklist.name: Distinct situations MUST NOT be combined
checklist.description: The 4999-cent case and the 5000-cent case remain separate tests from each other, and the no-mutation check remains its own test. Folding either threshold case into the other, or into a general quote test, scores zero: a failure would no longer say which side of the boundary moved. Absorbing the no-mutation check into a scenario test scores zero as well, because it is a different claim about the same call.

checklist.name: Every field and value survives
checklist.description: All fourteen expectations remain: light parcel 839 / not free / parcel / 2 days / EUR, heavy 4199 / freight / 5 days / not free, free-shipping true / 0, 719 at 4999 cents, 0 at 5000 cents, and the order unchanged. Score proportionally. A combined test that checks only the shipping cost and drops the carrier, estimate or currency loses those fields.

checklist.name: A failure still names the field
checklist.description: The combined tests compare the returned object so that a mismatch reports which field differs - deep equality against a stated quote, or per-field equality checks within the one test. Comparing serialised strings scores at most half, and a truthiness or shape-only check scores zero.

checklist.name: One call per scenario
checklist.description: Each combined test calls quote once and asserts against the result it captured, rather than calling quote again per field as the current file does.

checklist.name: Names describe the scenario and its outcome
checklist.description: After combining, each test name states the situation and what the quote should be, not a single field. A name naming only one field of a test that now asserts five scores at most half.

checklist.name: Review document produced
checklist.description: A file named quote-test-review.md exists, says what was combined and on what basis, and names what was deliberately left separate.
